SELECT
  order_id,
  status,
  is_realized_revenue
FROM
  `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items`
WHERE
  is_realized_revenue = TRUE
  AND status NOT IN ('Complete',
    'Shipped',
    'Processing')

SELECT
  order_id,
  created_at,
  shipped_at,
  delivered_at,
  returned_at
FROM
  `apex-activewear.apex_activewear_bronze.order_items`
WHERE
  (shipped_at IS NOT NULL
    AND shipped_at < created_at)
  OR (delivered_at IS NOT NULL
    AND delivered_at < shipped_at)

WITH source_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    map.traffic_source,
    SUM(oi.sale_price) AS total_revenue
  FROM 
    `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items` AS oi
  JOIN 
    `apex-activewear.silver_layer.int_order_attribution` AS map
    ON oi.order_id = map.order_id
  GROUP BY 1
),
share_calc AS (
  SELECT
    traffic_source,
    100.0 * total_revenue / SUM(total_revenue) OVER() AS share_pct
  FROM 
    source_revenue
)

SELECT * FROM share_calc 
WHERE traffic_source = 'Direct' AND share_pct > 20

SELECT
  oe.user_id,
  ur.created_at AS user_signup,
  oe.created_at AS event_time
FROM
  `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_users` AS ur
JOIN
  `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_online_events` AS oe
USING
  (user_id)
WHERE
  oe.created_at < ur.created_at

SELECT
  order_id,
  sale_price
FROM
  `apex-activewear.silver_layer.stg_order_items`
WHERE
  sale_price < 0
  OR sale_price IS NULL
